test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"experience."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"experience"**, with an **"e"** after the **"x" **and before the **"r".**
 
• **"Experience"** means the knowledge or skill gained from doing something over time. (जीवन में किए गए काम; किसी काम कों देखने अथवा करने से प्राप्त ज्ञान अथवा कौशल, अनुभव, तजुरबा)
 
 
• **Example:** *After years of working in the field, she had a lot of **experience**__ to draw from.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Enigma" **is a correctly spelt word that means a mysterious or puzzling thing. ((व्‍यक्ति, वस्‍तु या परिस्थिति) जिसे समझना कठिन हो; पेचीदा)
 
• **"Equivocate"** is a correctly spelt word that means to use ambiguous language to avoid making a clear statement. (स्पष्ट बयान देने से बचने के लिए अस्पष्ट भाषा का प्रयोग करना)
 
• **"Effigy"** is a correctly spelt word that means a sculpture or model of a person, often made to be burned or destroyed as a symbol of protest. ((प्रसिद्घ या धार्मिक व्‍यक्ति या ईश्‍वर की) मूर्ति, (किसी व्‍यक्ति का भद्दा लगने वाला) पुतला)
